text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock B in stages as its price rose, locking in gains but potentially cutting short a winner; I should base sales on my plan and outlook, not just a gain feeling good.","My account fell across these periods despite my profitable Stock B sales, so I should assess the whole portfolio and its risks rather than focus on realized gains.","Losses feel especially painful to me, but I should avoid letting that fear or the discomfort of selling at a loss drive decisions; I’ll review positions calmly and trade only when my reasons have changed."]}
